key_insight: AlphaFISH combines spatial host and microbiome profiling with AI to map colorectal cancer tissue ecosystems and identify bacterial-immune patterns linked to recurrence.
clinical_relevance: This approach could help stratify colorectal cancer patients after resection by recurrence risk using biopsy-based spatial biomarkers, supporting more personalized follow-up.
method: Sequencing-free spatial profiling of host transcripts and microbes at subcellular resolution
Cohort-scale dual-omics dataset built from 149 colorectal biopsies across 68 patients
Transformer model trained on joint gene, spatial, and microbiome embeddings
evidence_signal: The model reported nearly 90% accuracy for predicting CRC pathological features and 81% accuracy for 1-year post-resection recurrence in 28 followed patients.
watch_item: The recurrence result is based on a small follow-up set, so broader validation is needed before clinical implementation.
paper_title: Cohort-scale Spatial Host-Microbiome Predicts Post-Resection Recurrence in Colorectal Cancer
